# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Luma — Stale path denylist
#
# Patterns (POSIX extended regex, one per line) for source files,
# directories, and CMake modules that have been removed or renamed.
# The Docs Consistency workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml) fails
# if any of these appear in the documentation or prompt files,
# catching references that outlived the thing they pointed at.
#
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Add a pattern
# here whenever you delete or rename a path that documentation might
# still mention.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Non-root README.md files were renamed to DIRECTORY.md (2026-08).
# The root README.md still exists — this pattern catches only paths
# with a named directory prefix (e.g. "docs/README.md"), excluding
# relative parent refs like "../README.md" which point to the root.
[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*/README\.md

# GraphicalUi and Luma Solaris were removed (2026-09). These patterns catch
# any lingering documentation reference to the deleted modules, assets,
# prelude, generators, CMake module, and CSS lint infrastructure.
graphicalui[a-z0-9_]*\.(cpp|hpp)
gui_prelude
generate_gui_assets\.mjs
generate_prelude_asset\.mjs
external/gui-framework
LumaWebView\.cmake
stylelint\.config\.mjs
